dialogues.speaker: Takahashi
dialogues.text: My family spent many generations in Bourou Village on Watatsumi Island. It's a small village with beautiful scenery, and people lead peaceful lives there.

dialogues.speaker: Takahashi
dialogues.text: When I was small, I would often listen to the sound of waterfalls nearby. I would stay there for the whole day...

dialogues.speaker: Takahashi
dialogues.text: If it wasn't for this war, I probably would never have left my home and would have just spent a quiet, peaceful life there instead...
